content:
Hello everyone,

I've completed my first major lean project: formalization of the Lindstrom-Gessel-Viennot lemma and Binet-Cauchy determinant formula!

https://github.com/mmgorg/lindstrom_gessel_viennot/tree/main

I'm new here and never worked with GitHub before so I'm not quite sure what to do now. Should I get a local copy of the Formal Book repository and make a PR?

Btw, is the repo still maintained? I see that lean-toolchain is v4.27.0-rc1, while the latest version is already v4.34.0-rc2. If not, it would be great to revive it, involve new people in the work, and see the book formalized!

yeah, there has been very little activity lately, but perhaps a good time to revive...
Great that you have the LGV-Lemma!

Happy to bump it later this week, unless you make a pr before then
I'm preparing the bump to v4.33 now
Okay, I'll make a PR after the bump then.
the repo is now bumped and even lake builds without warnings for v4.34.0-rc2
